req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. We test: (1) positive — OPTIONS to a known endpoint returns 200 with both CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent path returns 4xx (client error, not 2xx); (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header triggers the pre-flight response with exact header values; (4) decision-table — OPTIONS without Origin still returns 2xx; (5) equivalence — OPTIONS to multiple valid endpoints all return 2xx with CORS headers. Assertions are exact-value to kill constant/operator mutations.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_acam_and_acah
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_acam_and_acah():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    acam = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    acah = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert acam != '', f'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must not be empty, got: {repr(acam)}'
    assert acah != '', f'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must not be empty, got: {repr(acah)}'

test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_acam_and_acah()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_path_returns_4xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /nonexistent_endpoint_xyz does not exist in httpbin routing
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /nonexistent_endpoint_xyz with Origin header
expected: HTTP status code is 4xx (client error), not 2xx
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_path_returns_4xx():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent_endpoint_xyz_r039',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for unknown path, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'Should not return 200 for unknown path'
    assert r.status_code != 500, 'Should not return 500 for unknown path'

test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_path_returns_4xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_acam_contains_get_method
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
OPTIONS request sent to /get endpoint which only supports GET
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get with Access-Control-Request-Method: GET
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_acam_contains_get_method():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://test.example.org',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    acam = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert 'GET' in acam, f'Expected GET in Access-Control-Allow-Methods, got: {repr(acam)}'
    acah = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert acah is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers header must be present'

test_cors_preflight_options_acam_contains_get_method()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No Origin header is sent (non-CORS request)
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /post without Origin header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx():
    r = client.options('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 without Origin header, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 500, 'Must not return 500'
    assert r.status_code != 400, 'Must not return 400 for missing Origin'

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_2xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to each of /get, /post, /put, /delete, /patch with Origin header
Collect status codes and CORS headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_2xx():
    endpoints = ['/get', '/post', '/put', '/delete', '/patch']
    for ep in endpoints:
        r = client.options(
            ep,
            headers={
                'Origin': 'http://example.com',
                'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
            }
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{ep}: Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
        acam = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
        assert acam != '', f'{ep}: Access-Control-Allow-Methods must not be empty'
        acah = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
        assert acah != '', f'{ep}: Access-Control-Allow-Headers must not be empty'

test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_2xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_acam_not_empty_string_boundary
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS to /delete with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: DELETE
Check that Access-Control-Allow-Methods length is greater than 0
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_acam_not_empty_string_boundary():
    r = client.options(
        '/delete',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://boundary.example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'DELETE',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'X-Custom-Header'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    acam = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert len(acam) > 0, f'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must have length > 0, got {len(acam)}'
    assert len(acam) != 0, 'Boundary: length must not be exactly 0'
    acah = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert len(acah) > 0, f'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must have length > 0, got {len(acah)}'
    assert 'DELETE' in acam, f'DELETE must appear in Access-Control-Allow-Methods, got: {repr(acam)}'

test_cors_preflight_options_acam_not_empty_string_boundary()
